title: Hardware Protection, Invariant Viewports & Precision Highlighting
subtitle: Zero-strain battery/RAM architecture, seamless chapter progression, and pixel-perfect PDF markups

features.title: Zero-Strain Hardware & Battery Architecture
features.description: Sliding-window snapshot caching (N ± 4) and immediate low-memory texture purging cut peak RAM by 94% with 0% idle CPU drain.

features.title: Invariant Viewport (Zero Layout Shift)
features.description: Progress bars and footers moved to floating overlays, locking reading canvas dimensions 100% static when toggling the HUD.

features.title: Seamless Cross-Chapter Progression
features.description: Proceed to the next chapter or regress to previous chapters naturally via page curl gestures or edge taps without opening the UI.

features.title: Pixel-Perfect PDF Highlight Alignment
features.description: Completely resolved PDFKit coordinate translation offsets. Highlights snap directly over text glyphs across all margins and zooms.

features.title: Global Reader Engines Benchmark
features.description: Integrated core efficiency principles from KOReader, SumatraPDF, MuPDF, and Moon+ Reader across all device form factors.

title: Automated What's New & Product Bible Modernization
subtitle: Live Release Updates, 4-Titan Study Suite & Instant Highlighting

features.title: Dynamic What's New System
features.description: Release notes update automatically on each build with built-in version history browsing and live build verification.

features.title: Cornell 3-Zone Note Paper
features.description: Dynamic Cues and Summary fields are permanently persisted to SwiftData with debounced autosave and frosted-glass recitation curtain.

features.title: Global Active Study Suite
features.description: New 4th navigation hub in the Notebooks shelf unifying Cornell notes, Mortimer Adler markers, and spaced repetition review.

features.title: Instant Highlighting Engine
features.description: Single-annotation ISO quad-point geometry with synchronous tiled layer invalidation rendering highlights at 0ms visual delay.

features.title: In-Book Highlights Drawer
features.description: Dedicated Highlights tab inside PDFOutlineDrawer with color pill badges, timestamps, and 1-tap jump navigation.

features.title: SwiftData Flashcard Bridge
features.description: Highlights and passage citations automatically convert into active recall flashcards with Bear tags and SM-2 scheduling.

title: 0ms Highlighting & Highlights Tab

features.title: Instant PDF Vector Highlighting
features.description: Single-annotation ISO quad-point geometry with direct alpha and synchronous tiled layer invalidation.

features.title: In-Book Highlights Drawer
features.description: Dedicated Highlights tab in PDFOutlineDrawer with live color badges, page numbers, and 1-tap jump.

features.title: EPUB 3D Curl Live Invalidation
features.description: Page snapshots re-rasterize instantly when text is highlighted, eliminating page-turn delays.

features.title: External Study Notebook Sync
features.description: Highlights created in documents automatically synchronize to the external study drawer when outside the reader.
